title: 2027 年多數船型運力成長快於需求；貨櫃轉弱、亞歐線壓力最大；油輪中成品油輪優於原油輪；LNG 有望受新產能與長程貿易帶動走強
In 2027 capacity outgrows demand in most segments: containers soften with Asia–Europe hit hardest, product tankers beat crude, and LNG should strengthen on new supply and longer hauls

name: 貨櫃
Containers
why: 本站觀點：2027 年貨櫃整體偏弱。BIMCO 預估兩種荷姆茲情境下供給成長都快於需求；蘇伊士運河逐步恢復通航後，船舶需求成長可能再少約 5 個百分點。
Our view: containers soften overall in 2027. BIMCO sees supply outgrowing demand under both Hormuz scenarios, and a gradual Suez return could cut ship-demand growth by about 5 more percentage points.
約 35% 航次已回到蘇伊士運河，分析機構與 Maersk 預期 2027 年第一季全面恢復；每趟往返可省 1–2 週、所需船數減少，新增的超大型貨櫃船也主要投入這條線。

About 35% of sailings are back through Suez, and analysts and Maersk expect a full return by Q1 2027; each round trip saves 1–2 weeks and needs fewer ships, and most new ultra-large ships also go to this trade.

t: Container News：Maersk 預計 2027 年 3 月前全面復航
Container News: Maersk eyes full Suez return by March 2027

why: 不經蘇伊士運河、不受恢復通航影響；中國對東南亞出口持續成長，船型以中小型為主，受超大型新船衝擊較小。
Does not use Suez, so unaffected by the return; China's exports to Southeast Asia keep growing, and the trade uses mainly small and mid-size ships, less exposed to the ultra-large newbuild wave.

name: 散裝
Dry bulk
why: 2026 年繞道拉長航程撐住需求，2027 年這個效果消退；若荷姆茲重新開放，被困波斯灣的船也會回到市場。兩種情境下供給都快於需求。
Longer rerouted voyages prop up 2026 demand; in 2027 that fades, and if Hormuz reopens ships trapped in the Gulf return. Supply outgrows demand in both scenarios.

name: 原油輪
Crude tankers
rows: 紅海／蘇伊士航線預期 2027 年第一季全面恢復，中東經蘇伊士往歐洲的航程縮短
Red Sea/Suez routing is expected to fully return by Q1 2027, shortening Middle East–Europe voyages via Suez
若荷姆茲恢復通航，中東出口反彈，BIMCO 預估 2027 年需求 +17% 至 +19.5%，短期可能強於預期
If Hormuz reopens, Middle East exports rebound; BIMCO sees 2027 demand +17% to +19.5%, so the near term could beat expectations
why: 本站觀點：原油輪 2027 年偏弱。荷姆茲恢復帶來的反彈屬一次性；紅海復航縮短航程、新船交付增加後，運價難以維持目前高檔，遠期運價也已反映回落。

Our view: crude tankers soften in 2027. A Hormuz rebound is one-off; with shorter Suez routings and more deliveries, rates are unlikely to hold today's highs, and forward rates already price a decline.

name: 成品油輪
Product tankers
rows: 歐洲結構性缺柴油：2025 年進口逾半來自中東；荷姆茲受阻後，9 月中東對歐出口降至每日 11 萬桶（六年低）
Europe is structurally short of diesel: over half of 2025 imports came from the Middle East; after Hormuz, September Middle East exports to Europe fell to 110 kb/d (a six-year low)
替代貨源轉向美國：美國占歐盟柴油進口約 32%（2025 年 17%），橫越大西洋的長程貿易增加
Replacement comes from the US: about 32% of EU diesel imports (17% in 2025), adding long-haul Atlantic trade
歐洲柴油裂解價差 10 月約 $98／桶、亞洲柴油利潤 9 月創 $87 新高，正常約 $20–40
European diesel cracks near $98/bbl in October and Asian diesel margins a record $87 in September, vs a normal $20–40
2027 年運力 +7.5% 至 +8.5%（BIMCO）；紅海復航會縮短中東、印度往歐洲的航程
2027 capacity +7.5% to +8.5% (BIMCO); a Red Sea return shortens Middle East and India–Europe voyages
why: 本站觀點：成品油輪 2027 年相對原油輪看好。歐洲失去俄國柴油後高度依賴進口，俄國煉油廠持續遭攻擊、出口禁令延續，替代貨源來自美國等更遠的地方，長程貿易支撐用船需求。

Our view: product tankers beat crude in 2027. Having lost Russian diesel, Europe depends on imports; Russian refineries keep being hit and export bans continue, so replacement barrels come from farther away, such as the US, supporting ship demand.

The EU fully bans Russian LNG from 1 Jan 2027 (short-term contracts since Apr 2026); Europe replaces it from farther sources such as the US
2027 年仍約 95 艘新船交付；2026 年 10 月現貨運價已較 3 月高點回落八至九成
About 95 newbuilds still deliver in 2027; spot rates in Oct 2026 were 80–90% below the March peak
why: 本站觀點：2027 年 LNG 偏強。出口量隨新產能與荷姆茲恢復而增加，加上貨源轉向美國、航程拉長，用船需求成長有機會快於船隊；主要風險是新船交付仍多。

Our view: LNG firms in 2027. Exports rise with new capacity and a Hormuz reopening, and the shift to US supply lengthens voyages, so ship demand can outgrow the fleet; the main risk is the heavy delivery schedule.
